# Rohit Singh Dev

> Digital Marketing & SEO Professional passionate about helping businesses grow their online presence through effective SEO, content strategy, website management, and performance-driven marketing.

Rohit Singh Dev (also known as Rohit Dev) has hands-on experience managing online stores, optimizing product listings, improving website performance, and supporting business growth through data-driven strategies. He works with website-building platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, Wix, and Weebly to create, manage, and optimize professional websites.

His experience includes Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Trends, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Content Management Systems (CMS), and Web Development. As a Vibe Coder, he actively explores AI tools, automation solutions, and emerging digital trends.
